conflicts: 237Np hyperfine B constants: the Laboratoire Aime Cotton table (Fred et al. 1977) gives B = 645 MHz for the ground level and 264 MHz for the 25075 cm^-1 level; the high-resolution Mainz measurement (2024) gives 928(10) and 323(8) MHz. The A constants agree (778 vs 776.08(20); 1470 vs 1470.09(18) MHz). The Mainz values are the entries; all other B values taken from the old table should be treated as rough.
239Np nuclear moments: the abstract of Kaja et al. (Eur. Phys. J. A 2024) prints mu = +3.18(2) mu_N and Q = +4.05(8) eb, the text prints +3.18(4) mu_N and +4.05(2) eb.

Selected-wavelength table versus level tables: a few truncated level energies in the wavelength table differ by one unit from the level tables (e.g. '5 184' for 5185.015 cm^-1); the level pair was always fixed by J and the observed wavenumber.
not_found: transition probabilities / oscillator strengths / branching fractions of Np I lines: none located; only emission intensities on a coarse scale are available
lifetime of the 25075.15 cm^-1 (J=13/2) level: Kaja et al. 2024 give only an upper limit (shorter than the 50 ns laser pulse can resolve); the number is in a figure and was not read
radiative lifetimes of 5 levels measured by Worden & Conway, J. Opt. Soc. Am. 69, 733 (1979) (mentioned in the Laboratoire Aime Cotton introduction): paper not opened
three-step Ti:sapphire and dye-laser resonance ionization schemes for Np trace analysis (Mainz, cited by Kaja et al. as refs 6 and 8): originals not opened, not entered
two lines of the selected-wavelength table could not be matched to the level tables and are left out: 504.466 nm (21851 J=11/2 - 2033 J=9/2) and 601.122 nm (21246 J=3/2 - 4615 J=5/2)
six of the 93 matched lines of the selected-wavelength table (intensity 300, highest lower levels) were dropped to keep the page at 90 lines
Lande g and hyperfine constants exist in the table for many more levels than are entered here (only levels touched by the selected lines are entered)
notes: Levels and classifications: archived online version (2002 captures) of the Blaise & Wyart actinide tables (Laboratoire Aime Cotton); energies refer to 237Np (hyperfine centre of gravity). In that level table the column headed 'J' after the energy is the Lande g factor. Hyperfine A and B of the table are printed in 10^-3 cm^-1 and were converted to MHz (1 x 10^-3 cm^-1 = 29.979 MHz; marked derived). Kaja et al. quote the first-step levels as 25075.15, 25277.64, 25342.48 and 25551.93 cm^-1; the three-decimal energies of the level table are used as identifiers. 'relative_intensity' is the emission intensity printed in the selected-wavelength table (300, 1000, 3000 or 10000) and only ranks lines. Isotope shifts are nu(239Np) - nu(237Np). Configurations are stored without parent terms (full printed string in each level note); terms printed in parentheses (leading component 25-50 %) are stored without the parentheses.
